# Elevate the Circuit (ETC)

> Elevate the Circuit (ETC) is a national non-profit youth forensics initiative empowering middle and high school students and educators to found, grow, and sustain thriving speech and debate chapters across the United States. All curriculum kits, starter packages, and coaching resources are 100% free.

## Overview & Mission
Elevate the Circuit partners with public and private middle and high schools to eliminate barriers to competitive forensics. Founded by student leaders Derin Gulkanat and Ishan Saha, ETC provides:
- **100% Free Turnkey Resources**: Novice debate curriculums, topic briefs, club constitutions, judge rubrics, and starter kits.
- **Varsity & Alumni Coaching**: Mentorship connecting emerging chapters with experienced high school and collegiate debaters.
- **Tournament Organization**: Accessible local and regional forensics competitions, certified judge pools, and tournament fee grants.
- **Chapter Founding Support**: Direct coordinator guidance for students and faculty advisors launching new speech & debate clubs.
- **Multi-State Leadership & Practice Scrimmages**: Inter-school scrimmage pairings and collaborative multi-state assemblies.

## Supported Speech & Debate Events
- **Public Forum (PF)**: 2v2 partner debate on current domestic and foreign policy topics.
- **Lincoln-Douglas (LD)**: 1v1 philosophical and ethical value debate.
- **Policy Debate (CX)**: 2v2 research-intensive policy advocacy and counter-plan debate.
- **Congressional Debate**: Legislative chamber simulation using parliamentary procedure.
- **SPAR Debate**: Spontaneous Argumentation designed for middle schoolers and novices.
- **Original Oratory (OO)**: 10-minute memorized persuasive speech on a societal issue.
- **Extemporaneous Speaking**: 7-minute current events speech with 30 minutes of preparation.
- **Impromptu Speaking**: Quick-fire 7-minute combined prep and delivery prompt speech.
- **Interpretation Events**: Dramatic Interpretation (DI), Humorous Interpretation (HI), Duo Interpretation, and Program Oral Interpretation (POI).

## Key Pages & URLs
- [Overview & Homepage](https://elevatethecircuit.org/): National footprint map, impact statistics (140+ active student debaters, 6+ partner schools across North Carolina, California, and expanding nationwide), and core mission pillars.
- [Free Debate Resources & Curriculum Hub](https://elevatethecircuit.org/resources.html): Downloadable starter kits, 12-week novice curriculums, format guides, and event comparison cheat sheets.
- [National Chapter Tracker](https://elevatethecircuit.org/chapter-tracker.html): Live directory of active middle and high school chapters, member counts, events offered, and regional coordinators.
- [Start a Chapter Application](https://elevatethecircuit.org/get-involved.html): Official application for students, teachers, and parents to launch an ETC chapter and receive free monthly resource drives.
- [Contact & Coordinator Desk](https://elevatethecircuit.org/contact.html): Direct inquiries for school partnerships, curriculum requests, and volunteer coaching/judging.
